title: Safety Study of XP12B in Women With Menorrhagia
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety of XP12B in women with heavy menstrual bleeding associated with menorrhagia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women with menorrhagia
* 18-49 years of age
* Regularly occuring menstrual periods

Exclusion Criteria:

* History or presence of clinically significant disease or abnormalities that might confound the study
* History of bilateral oophorectomy or hysterectomy
